steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Sinner, what a distant name. It's just some troublesome powers I got a few years ago. Since we're about to travel together, just call me McQueen.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Don't flatter yourself. When did I promise to take you with me?

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: But you do need me, Miss, don't you?

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: There are countless monsters here, and getting out with just yourself, Miss Lisa, and an audio navigator, it won't be easy.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: My special power is more aggressive than yours, and I can help you destroy them. You know the layout of this place and can take me out... I'd like to think that fate brought us together.
The agent lowers her voice and approaches Lisa. She takes Lisa's right hand and bends down, trying to prove her sincerity by kissing Lisa's hand.
But Lisa jerks her hand away and almost slaps the agent in the face.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: More like fate sent you to test me...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Let's get this straight: I'm not interested in your deal. I'll take you on the side, but if you hold me back, I won't hesitate to ditch you.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Because we're heading the same way! And I also have conditions: first, don't use such a disgusting tone to get close to me. I'm not one of those superficial lords and ladies in Eastside. I don't buy that.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Second... remember to keep more than five meters away from me, and don't touch me. It's nauseating.
Ignoring McQueen's stunned face, Lisa finishes and dusts off her right hand with a frown, bypassing McQueen and heading off on her own.
When McQueen comes back to her senses, Lisa is already quite far away, without the slightest intention of waiting for her new partner.
Looking at her eccentric guide, McQueen shrugs and smiles, patting the forged invitation that she prepared in her pocket.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: She's a bit more innocent than rumored, so it looks like I won't have to use you today.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: But I wonder if the guests from MBCC will bring any changes to the plan...
